title: Common Phrasal Verbs list 4
intro: Learn the most common phrasal verbs in English with the following list.

meanings: When you collide with something by accident.
To make copies; to print
To suddenly leave without permission or to flee.
When you do not have resources anymore.
To review or rehearse something again.
When an amount reaches a certain cost.
To perceive something physically.
To recognize the true intentions of someone or something.
To show something to impress people
When you spend the night at someone else’s house, usually with friends.
To resemble someone because of similar characteristics.
To remove something.
To retract something you said.
To reclaim something that belong to you.
To write something down in a piece of paper.
To dismantle an object.
To finally understand something.
To provide lodging for someone or something.
To become successful.
To depart or leave.

items.en: To take off something / to take something off
meanings: To remove clothing, accessories or objects.
To assume the responsibility of something.
To have control over something.
To separate the components of objects.
To start a new hobby or something that attracts you.
To occupy space.
To use a lot of time.

items.en: To try out something / to try something out
meanings: To test something to see if it works.
To consume everything provided by something.
To eliminate something forever.
When you exercise.
When you try to find a solution for something.
